subject: Versatile shearlocks for tight spaces
body_content:
You don't often get email from marie-anne@magnetic-solutions.co.uk. Learn why this is important
Preserve headroom AND security
 

Clean and professional finish

The MS41 range of shearlocks includes a range of different configurations to meet the needs of your project. With combinations of surface or flush mount magnets and armatures, you'll find the MS41 for you. 

Preserve headroom

The slim design of the MS41 keeps doorways clearer even for tall people! 

Plus with 1000kg of holding force, they're robust and keep restricted areas reliably safe and secure.
